title: US Foods Order Structure
description: Documentation of the data structure for foodservice orders in US Foods ordering and integration systems

fields.name: orderId
fields.description: Unique order identifier assigned by US Foods systems

fields.name: customerId
fields.description: US Foods customer account number (6-7 digit account)

fields.name: orderDate
fields.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the order was placed

fields.name: deliveryDate
fields.description: Expected delivery date based on customer's delivery schedule

fields.name: distributionCenter
fields.description: Name or code of the US Foods distribution center fulfilling the order

itemStructure.lineNumber: Integer line number within the order

fields.name: purchaseOrderNumber
fields.description: Customer's internal PO number for EDI and accounting reconciliation

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Special delivery instructions, substitution preferences, or order notes
fields.example: Please deliver to back dock, ring bell

integration_notes.gdsn_sync: Product information (ingredients, allergens, nutrition facts, images) synchronized via GS1 GDSN through a data pool
